note: Reviews are about E Mortgage Capital as a company, not Pat personally and not ADU financing. Cards are short summaries written by us (no quotes) of 5-star reviews we picked: 8 from Google, 6 from Yelp, 5 from Zillow (all read in a browser on 2026-10-24) and 5 of the 6 BBB summaries shown on Pat's own site (read 2026-10-23); the sixth said a loan settled 'in under a month', a timeline claim, so it is left out. Loan officers' names, rates, timelines, VA, debt and reverse-mortgage reviews are left out. Ratings and counts are for the whole company on 2026-10-24. BBB's page would not load for us (it asks for a human check), so no BBB rating is shown.
